# Feature: Heavy orb — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #17 (Heavy orb) from Orbs before it is used in real levels. Effect: push it onto a scale to collect it. Unique: this orb is pushed like a block, never walked over. Useful: attaches a pushing puzzle to the orb goal itself. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** push it onto a scale to collect it.

**So that** attaches a pushing puzzle to the orb goal itself.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Heavy orb for the first time in its teaching room (mech-17-heavy-orb-room). Teaching moment: First room: a heavy orb and a scale, with a wall pocket beside the pushing lane. A player who pushes it straight ahead without checking the far side pockets it where it cannot be pulled back and restarts the room, which teaches that pushing an orb is chosen by where the orb will end up. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: The orb is a solid object you push one tile at a time like a block
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It cannot be pushed into walls or water
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Pushing it onto a scale tile locks it there and counts it as collected

## Edge Cases & Rules

- The orb is a solid object you push one tile at a time like a block
- It cannot be pushed into walls or water
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Heavy orb's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-17-heavy-orb-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/orbs.yml mechanic #17.
